title: Algebraic techniques
summary: Pronumerals and expressions, substituting, equivalent expressions, like terms, multiplying and dividing, expanding brackets and applying algebra.

cards.title: Introduction to algebra
cards.rule: A pronumeral is a letter for a number. \(3x\) means \(3 \times x\).
lines: In \(3x + 5\): the coefficient is 3, the constant is 5

cards.title: Substituting
cards.rule: Replace each letter with its number, then work it out.

cards.title: Equivalent expressions
cards.rule: Equivalent expressions are equal for every value of the letter.

cards.title: Like terms
cards.rule: Only terms with the same letters and powers can be added or subtracted.

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing
cards.rule: Multiply the numbers, then the letters. Divide like a fraction.

cards.title: Expanding brackets
cards.rule: Multiply everything inside by the term outside.

cards.title: Applying algebra
cards.rule: Pick a letter for the unknown and write a rule.
lines: Gym: $10 to join plus $5 a visit: \(C = 10 + 5v\). 8 visits: \(\$50\)
Rectangle, width \(x\), length \(x + 2\): perimeter \(4x + 4\). If \(x = 3\), that's 16.
30 students on each of \(b\) buses: \(30b\). 4 buses: 120 students
